summary: To connect Pipedrive via OAuth 2.0, developers must create an OAuth application within a Pipedrive Developer Sandbox account to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret. Public Marketplace apps require a detailed listing submission and mandatory review taking up to 21 business days, while Private apps can be set directly to Live.

difficulty.headline: Self-serve setup for private use and draft testing, but publishing a public integration to the Pipedrive Marketplace requires a comprehensive review process taking up to 21 business days.

factors.label: Marketplace Review Wait Time
factors.detail: Public marketplace app submissions undergo thorough manual testing and reviews can take up to 21 business days.

evidence.quote: Due to a surge in demand and ongoing vacations, public app reviews may take up to 21 business days.

factors.label: Developer Sandbox Requirement
factors.detail: OAuth applications can only be created and managed inside a Pipedrive Developer Sandbox account.

evidence.quote: You must have a developer sandbox account for app creation to see Developer Hub.

factors.label: Short Token Lifetimes
factors.detail: OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes, requiring robust refresh token management in your application.

factors.label: Single Callback URL Constraint
factors.detail: Pipedrive restricts each app registration to a single callback URL.

evidence.quote: Please keep in mind that we allow only one callback URL per app.

can_test_before_approval.detail: Draft apps can be installed and fully tested immediately within the developer's sandbox account prior to submitting for review.

evidence.quote: Once you’ve completed filling up the Basic info and OAuth & access scopes, we advise you to start installing your app and testing it to see how it works.

requirements.label: Pipedrive Developer Sandbox Account
requirements.detail: A dedicated Sandbox account is required to access the Developer Hub and create OAuth apps.

requirements.label: OAuth Callback URL
requirements.detail: A HTTPS redirect URI to receive authorization codes during user authorization.

evidence.quote: This tab has two required fields – App name and OAuth Callback URL.

requirements.label: Developer Partner Agreement Acceptance
requirements.detail: Developers must agree to the Pipedrive Developer Partner Agreement terms.

evidence.quote: Review and understand the requirements of the Pipedrive Developer Partner Agreement

requirements.label: Marketplace Listing Assets (Public Apps)
requirements.detail: High-quality screenshots (3-5 images), app description, support links, and onboarding guides are required for Marketplace review.

evidence.quote: Your app listing includes 3-5 high-quality images that are easily readable and include assistive cues

steps.title: Request a Pipedrive Developer Sandbox Account
steps.detail: Sign up for a free developer sandbox account on the Pipedrive Developer portal to access the Developer Hub.

evidence.quote: You must have a developer sandbox account for app creation to see Developer Hub.

steps.title: Create a Draft OAuth Application
steps.detail: In Developer Hub, select 'Create an app' and choose whether to register a Public App or Private App, entering the App Name and single Callback URL.
steps.agent_assist: Draft the App Name, choose the initial Callback URL, and evaluate whether a Public or Private App type fits the product deployment model.

evidence.quote: To register a new app, click on the green “Create an app” button (or “+ Create an app” if you have existing apps) followed by “Create public app”.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Access Scopes and Retrieve Client Credentials
steps.detail: Select the required API access scopes under the 'OAuth & access scopes' tab and save to generate the app's Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.agent_assist: Map the required Pipedrive API endpoints to their minimum required scopes and save the generated client_id and client_secret.

evidence.quote: This is where you will get your app’s unique client_id and client_secret for OAuth authorization.

steps.title: Implement OAuth 2.0 Flow and Token Refresh Handler
steps.detail: Build the authorization redirect endpoint, code exchange logic at https://oauth.pipedrive.com/oauth/token, and automatic refresh handling for 60-minute access tokens.
steps.agent_assist: Implement authorization code exchange, Basic Auth header generation (Base64 client_id:client_secret), and automatic token refresh prior to 60-minute expiration.

steps.title: Install and Test Draft App in Sandbox
steps.detail: Click 'Install & test' in Developer Hub to perform test authorization flows and verify API data retrieval using your sandbox account.
steps.agent_assist: Prepare test scripts and sample data requests to verify OAuth flow execution and data responses within the Sandbox environment.

evidence.quote: Once you’ve completed filling up the Basic info and OAuth & access scopes, we advise you to start installing your app and testing it to see how it works.

steps.title: Prepare Marketplace Listing and Documentation
steps.detail: For Public apps, fill out listing details including app summary, full integration description, support contact, pricing link, and 3-5 screenshots.
steps.agent_assist: Draft clear marketplace summaries, full step-by-step installation instructions, support info, and pre-submission checklist verification.

evidence.quote: The app full description is specific to your integration, well-written and has a comprehensive overview of what the app does

steps.title: Submit App for Marketplace Review
steps.detail: Preview the public app listing form and click 'Send to review' to initiate formal Marketplace evaluation.
steps.agent_assist: Provide a submission message, review checklist, and verified links for demo video or setup instructions.

evidence.quote: Preview your app listing and check that the information is accurate

steps.title: Wait for Pipedrive Review and Approval
steps.detail: Pipedrive reviews technical implementation, installation UX, listing details, and security compliance.

evidence.quote: Due to a surge in demand and ongoing vacations, public app reviews may take up to 21 business days.

steps.title: Publish App Live
steps.detail: Once approved by Pipedrive (or immediately for Private apps by selecting 'Change to Live'), update app status to Live to allow external customer connections.
steps.agent_assist: Verify production OAuth redirect endpoints and environment settings.

evidence.quote: Once approved, your app status will change to Live

gotchas.title: Single Callback URL per Application
gotchas.detail: Pipedrive strictly permits only one callback URL per app registration. Multi-tenant integrations must route all accounts through a unified backend callback or state parameter handler.

evidence.quote: Please keep in mind that we allow only one callback URL per app.

gotchas.title: Short Token Expiration Period
gotchas.detail: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Your application must store refresh tokens securely and renew access tokens automatically.

gotchas.title: Developer Hub Restricted to Sandbox Accounts
gotchas.detail: Developer Hub is not present in standard production accounts. OAuth application credentials must be registered inside a dedicated Developer Sandbox account.

evidence.quote: OAuth app management (Developer Hub) is only available in Sandbox accounts, not in production accounts.

gotchas.title: Immutable App Type
gotchas.detail: App type selection (Public vs Private) cannot be changed in Developer Hub once created.

evidence.quote: NB: Do pick your app type carefully, as it cannot be changed later on Developer Hub.

blockers.problem: OAuth callback URL mismatch error during authorization
blockers.why: The redirect_uri parameter supplied in the GET request does not match the single callback URL registered in the app form.
blockers.fix: Ensure the authorization request redirect_uri matches the single Callback URL saved under Basic Info in Developer Hub.

evidence.quote: The callback URL you provided when you registered your app.

blockers.problem: External clients cannot authorize or install the application
blockers.why: The app remains in 'Draft' status, restricting authorization exclusively to users within the developer's sandbox company.
blockers.fix: Switch status to 'Live' for Private apps, or complete Marketplace review submission for Public apps.

evidence.quote: While an app is in Draft, it can only be authorized by users in the same Pipedrive account where the app was created.

blockers.problem: App rejection during Marketplace review due to scope creep
blockers.why: Requesting broad or unneeded permissions violates Pipedrive's principle of requesting minimal scopes.
blockers.fix: Remove unneeded permissions under 'OAuth & access scopes' in Developer Hub and re-test core functionality before resubmitting.

uncertain: Specific SLAs for Private App status propagation after clicking 'Change to Live'.
Exact tier-specific rate limits beyond the default 480 requests per 2 seconds limit for OAuth apps.
